sceneDescription: Isikhungo simele inothi ye-Helia yesiphequluli. Amanothi ahlaza satjani akhanyako njengamanje ahlanganiswe nesiphequluli begodu anolayini oya phakathi. Amanothi we-violet atholakala ngokusebenzisa isiphequluli kodwana awaxhunyiwe. Ama-node wegolide ziinhlanganisela ezivulekileko ezibikwe yi-Kubo daemon yendawo ehlukileko; akusizo iinhlanganisela zesiphequluli begodu azinalayini eya esikhungweni lesi. Iinkwekwezi ezihlongakeleko zilondoloza umlando ongahlanganisiweko, begodu ubufakazi bazo zisuswa ngemva kokuthi zihlukaniswe. Ibanga ukusuka emabalazweni aphakathi lilinganise ukulibaziseka; ontanga abangalinganiswako bathatha umjikelezo wangaphandle, begodu amaqembu we-engele ahlanganisa ukuthutha okubonwako. Iinkwekwezi ezihlobisa ngemuva azijameleli ontanga. I-orbit yangaphandle ebuthakathaka itshwaya indawo ye-Kubo engeniswako begodu akusikho ukuxhumana. Umphetho wokudlulisa uvela kwaphela lokha i-ID yokudlulisela ikhona kusethi yontanga ebonwako; ithopoloji yontanga-kuya-ontanga engakhethi ayikaze iphethwe. Sebenzisa umhloli wabontanga ukuthola ilwazi elifanako ngefomu lomtlolo.
fallbackBody: Idivayisi le ayikwazanga ukwenza ubujamo be-WebGL obuphephileko. Ukutjheja okubukhoma kwe-Helia kuhlala kutholakala ngokusebenzisa umhloli wabontanga.
distanceAxis: Ibanga = ukulibaziseka okulinganisiweko · umjikelezo wangaphandle = ongakalinganiswa

brightnessAxis: Ukukhanya kwelayini yokuhlanganisa = ukuphendula okulinganisiweko okurhabako
observationScopeBody: Indawo efinyelelekako yesiphequluli lesi kanye nokutjheja kwe-Kubo yendawo okungeniswe ngokukhanyako; ilandelelwe ku-2,048 begodu yenziwa ku-1,024, ingasi yoke inethiwekhi ye-IPFS.
heroTitle: Isiphequluli esibukhoma sokubuka · isibhakabhaka esiphilako sabantanga abafinyelelekako
heroBody: Isiphequluli lesi siqala abontanga abafikelelekako, silinganise iimpendulo zabo, begodu sinikela ubufakazi obuvela esigabeni lesi kwaphela. Akukho okulingisiweko lapha.
settingsSummaryAuto: Ikhwalithi ye-auto ivikela izinga lefreyimu begodu iyabuyisela lokha indawo nayipholileko.
settingsSummaryManual: Isethi ekhethiweko ikhiyiwe; ikhwalithi yesandla angeze yehle ngokuzenzakalelako.

controlsOrbit: Bamba ukuhudula kwesokunxele, nofana utjhugulukele kumodi yekhamera yokuchofoza ngesidleni, ukujikeleza.
controlsHover: Hambisa umlingani ukuze uthole imininingwane; thepha nofana chofoza ukufaka ikhadi layo lobufakazi.

controlsTouch: Ezikrinini zokuthinta, swayipha uye emjikelezweni, uthinte ukukhamba, bese uthinta ukuphina.
